_comment: Reference payload for SN-Deploy-Demo. Industry: Healthcare / Hospital IT Operations. Use this as a known-good shape and a few-shot example when generating payloads for other industries. Pass this object's JSON-stringified form as the `payload` argument.

categories.name: Clinical Systems
categories.description: Support for EHR, EMR, PACS, and other clinical applications used by physicians, nurses, and allied health staff.

categories.name: Medical Devices & IoT
categories.description: Connected medical devices, infusion pumps, patient monitors, and biomedical equipment integrations.

categories.name: Patient Portal & Telehealth
categories.description: Patient-facing portal access, telehealth video platform, and virtual visit support.

categories.name: HIPAA & Compliance
categories.description: Privacy, security, audit, and HIPAA compliance-related requests for protected health information.

categories.name: Pharmacy & Lab Systems
categories.description: Pharmacy management, e-prescribing, laboratory information systems, and order entry.

catalogItems.name: New Clinician EHR Access
catalogItems.short_description: Provision Epic/Cerner EHR account with role-based access for new physicians, nurses, or residents.

catalogItems.name: PACS Imaging Workstation Request
catalogItems.short_description: Request a radiology PACS workstation with diagnostic-grade monitors and DICOM viewer access.

catalogItems.name: Biomedical Device Onboarding
catalogItems.short_description: Register and network-onboard a new medical device (infusion pump, patient monitor, ventilator) on the clinical VLAN.

catalogItems.name: Telehealth Video Platform Setup
catalogItems.short_description: Configure a provider account on the telehealth platform for virtual patient visits.

catalogItems.name: Patient Portal Account Reset
catalogItems.short_description: Reset patient MyChart/portal credentials and verify identity per HIPAA guidelines.

catalogItems.name: PHI Access Audit Request
catalogItems.short_description: Request an audit report of PHI access for a specific patient record or user.

catalogItems.name: E-Prescribing (EPCS) Token Request
catalogItems.short_description: Issue a DEA EPCS hard/soft token for controlled substance e-prescribing.

catalogItems.name: Lab Interface Connectivity Request
catalogItems.short_description: Establish HL7 interface between LIS and a new reference laboratory or clinic.

incidents.short_description: Epic EHR slow response in ED during shift change
incidents.description: Emergency Department clinicians reporting 10-15 second delays loading patient charts in Epic Hyperspace between 06:45-07:30 during shift change. Impacting triage and order entry. Suspect Citrix session pool saturation.

incidents.short_description: PACS workstation unable to retrieve prior imaging studies
incidents.description: Radiologist workstation in Reading Room 3 cannot pull prior CT/MRI studies from PACS archive. Current studies load normally; only studies older than 90 days fail with DICOM C-MOVE timeout.

incidents.short_description: Infusion pump fleet offline from clinical VLAN
incidents.description: Approximately 40 BD Alaris infusion pumps on Tower B, floors 4-6 lost connectivity to the medication library server. Pumps operating in standalone mode. Biomedical and Network teams engaged.
Multiple providers report telehealth video calls disconnecting after 8-12 minutes. Audio remains, video freezes. Affecting outpatient behavioral health and primary care virtual visits.

incidents.short_description: Pharmacy e-prescribing failing for controlled substances
incidents.description: EPCS controlled substance prescriptions failing to transmit to Surescripts. Non-controlled prescriptions transmitting normally. Suspected DEA token signing certificate expiration.

incidents.short_description: Unauthorized PHI access alert - VIP patient record
incidents.description: Splunk SIEM triggered HIPAA break-the-glass alert for VIP patient record accessed by user outside care team. Compliance investigation initiated under HIPAA Privacy Rule.
